native_stack: ROS 1 Noetic, official D2SLAM: D2VINS (with D2Frontend: SuperPoint, MobileNetVLAD, LK), D2PGO (distributed ARock PGO with PCM), D2Comm
cnn_backend: ONNX Runtime 1.18.0 CPU execution provider (upstream builds use TensorRT on CUDA)
sensors: BstemSensors stereo cameras (as 8-bit grayscale) and IMU (standard 3-axis gyro from BstemSensors.imu(); raw accelerometer)
inter_robot_transport: BstemSensors.send/receive carrying unchanged LCM bytes; LCM is ttl=0 inside each container
